svg.aria-label: How one request flows. You ask the manager. It plans and briefs three crew members who work in parallel inside the guard, which checks listed tools and asks you or refuses: Kevin builds in his own git worktree, Ninja Hattori reviews read-only, Joe Gardner runs the test suites. Each hands back a full report and a summary. The manager verifies them and opens a pull request. You approve, and only then DevOps merges. 14 specialists, a few at a time.

g.text: 14 specialists, a few at a time
